input: Apply for a community allotment plot this season

gold.taskTitle: Apply for a community allotment plot this season
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to successfully apply for a community allotment plot within the current growing season.

questions.title: Which local council or allotment association are you applying through?
questions.description: Identify the specific organisation managing the allotment waiting list or applications.

questions.title: Have you applied for an allotment plot before?
questions.description: Understand the user's prior experience with the application process.

questions.title: What is your deadline for securing a plot this season?
questions.description: Establish any time constraints tied to the growing season or personal goals.

questions.title: Do you already know the plot size you want?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user has a preferred allotment size such as a full or half plot.

questions.title: Is there a specific allotment site you want to join?
questions.description: Determine if the user has a preferred location or is open to any available site nearby.

questions.title: Do you know if the site currently has a waiting list?
questions.description: Assess how long the process might take and whether alternative sites need to be considered.

questions.title: What documents or details will the application require?
questions.description: Find out what the user already knows about required information such as proof of address or personal ID.
